newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste buys Browning Ferris, Allied Waste assets.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste buys Browning Ferris, Allied Waste assets.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc. said Thursday it has acquired or will acquire assets from Browning-Ferris Industries Inc. and Allied Waste Industries Inc. for a total of $312 million in cash and stock.

USA Waste said it will acquire from Browning-Ferris 12 collection and hauling operations, two landfills, one transfer station and one materials recovery facility in Arizona, California, Florida, Indiana, Louisiana, New York and Pennsylvania. The operations being acquired have total annual revenues of about $125 million, it said.

From Allied, the company said it acquired the Chiquita Canyon landfill in the Los Angeles market and all of Allied's collection operations in the Washington D.C. market. The operations have annual sales of about $34 million.

Including Thursday's announcement, USA Waste's 1997 acquisitions will add revenues of about $918 million. This amount includes $509 million related to the Canadian transactions with Allied Waste and Waste Management and the assets purchased from Mid-American Waste.
USA Waste, based in Houston, is a solid waste management company serving customers in 36 states, the District of Columbia, Canada, Puerto Rico and Mexico.
